info.title: Ingestion Service
info.description: Manages data ingestion into OnePlatform. Provides connector lifecycle management (create, configure, sync), inbound webhook receivers for third-party push events, and file upload ingestion for CSV, JSON, TSV, and NDJSON files.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Connector instances — configured plugin integrations that pull data from external sources on a schedule or on-demand.

tags.name: Syncs
tags.description: Sync history and real-time progress tracking for connector sync jobs.

tags.name: Webhook Receivers
tags.description: Inbound webhook receiver management. Receivers accept push events from external systems using HMAC-verified HTTP POST requests.

tags.name: File Uploads
tags.description: One-shot file ingestion for CSV, JSON, TSV, and NDJSON. Accepts up to 5GB. Files are streamed to object storage and parsed asynchronously.
